item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find any reliable 2024 source showing Srettha using nuclear threats, nuclear brinkmanship, or apocalyptic nuclear language. I also did not find any 2024 source where he normalized nuclear use or hinted at escalation for prestige or leverage. The evidence base is therefore asymmetric: several responsible/peace-oriented or civilian nuclear references, but no credible contrary examples in the sources searched.","evidence":[{"title":"Thailand co-chaired the 15th ASEAN Regional Forum Inter-Sessional Meeting on Non-Proliferation and Disarmament in Honolulu, Hawaii","publisher":"Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kingdom of Thailand","date":"May 3, 2024","url":"https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/arfismonnpd-2?cate=5d5bcb4e15e39c306000683e","summary":"Thailand’s official line under Srettha’s government supported strengthening and transparency in nuclear non-proliferation and disarmament, explicitly aiming at the total elimination of nuclear weapons. This is strong positive evidence for restrained, responsible nuclear rhetoric.","question_ids":["1B.2","1B.1"]},{"title":"Statement of Prime Minister of the Kingdom of Thailand at the Summit for Democracy, 20 March 2024","publisher":"Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kingdom of Thailand","date":"March 20, 2024","url":"https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/summit-for-democracy-statement-2024?cate=5d5bcb4e15e39c3060006848","summary":"Srettha’s public rhetoric in this official statement emphasized democracy, rule of law, human rights, and responsible foreign relations. I found no nuclear-threat, brinkmanship, or apocalyptic framing in the statement.","question_ids":["1B.2"]},{"title":"Keynote speech by Prime Minister of Thailand at the 29th Nikkei Forum Future of Asia “Asian Leadership in an Uncertain World”","publisher":"Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kingdom of Thailand","date":"May 24, 2024","url":"https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/nikkeiforum-240524?menu=5d5bd3dd15e39c306002ab21&page=5d5bd3dd15e39c306002ab20","summary":"Srettha framed regional leadership in terms of mutual trust, constructive cooperation, and stability in an uncertain world.
